CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM 
    (
    SELECT
    BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS PeriodStartDate
    ,CASE WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE END AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS ProductId
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE

    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.ISLATEST = '1'
    WHERE  BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
UNION

    SELECT
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS PeriodStartDate
    ,CASE WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE END AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS ProductId
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE

    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC ON BCC.CRDACCT_NBR = BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.ISLATEST = '1'
	 WHERE  BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE RN = 1;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
         CustomerAccountId
        ,PeriodStartDate
        ,PeriodEndDate
        ,ProductId
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
        CustomerAccountId
        ,PeriodStartDate
        ,PeriodEndDate
        ,ProductId
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;


--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDAT
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct (
    CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,ProductId
    ,IsoCurrencyCode
    ,UsageCategoryId
    ,CommitmentId
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
    ,WORKFLOWID
    ,TASKRUNID
    ,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) as PeriodStartDate
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodEndDate)) as PeriodEndDate
,SRC.ProductId AS ProductId
,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
,NULL AS CommitmentId
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId


--INSERT RECORD TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct(
    CustomerAccountId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,ProductId
    ,IsoCurrencyCode
    ,UsageCategoryId
    ,CommitmentId
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
    ,WORKFLOWID
    ,TASKRUNID
    ,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId as CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) as PeriodStartDate
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndDate)) as PeriodEndDate
,ProductId as ProductId
,'PHP' as IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL as UsageCategoryId
,NULL as CommitmentId
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT') AND CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
